items.title: Charlie Bocage Interview, 1960-07-18
items.q: Well I had one sister named Boetha and uh, Lillian.

ctx.x: Well I had one sister named Boetha and uh, Lillian. And my father was uh, Leopold Vorkaige. And of course my other two brothers is uh, Henry and Boethaige, Henry Clay and uh, Peter Boethaige.
Do you have any cousins that play?
